plans.note: No limitation-of-liability heading in the supplied outline; the indemnity section is the nearest hook, and unlisted sections (3, 4, 6, 9, 11) may carry a cap. Confirm whether any mutual cap or consequential-damages waiver exists before proposing one.
Section 12 (INDEMNITY) is the operative provision; check whether TrueLink indemnifies us for third-party IP and hosting misconduct, or whether the flow runs one way from Client only.
No non-compete heading; any restraint on our business would most likely sit in the Client covenants (sec-8) or as a use restriction in the licence grant (sec-2).
Watch for an exclusive-hosting or sole-provider covenant embedded in the licence grant or Client covenants; nothing in the outline flags exclusivity expressly.
Pricing terms in sec-5 (COMPENSATION) are the only plausible home for an MFN; verify direction — MFN running to TrueLink would be off-playbook.
No non-solicitation heading; such clauses often ride along with Client covenants (sec-8) or the confidentiality section (sec-10).
No term/termination section appears in the supplied outline (likely one of the unlisted sections); flag the gap and request the full text before drafting a convenience-termination right.
Renewal mechanics are absent from the outline; if present they would sit with term/termination or with fee escalation in sec-5.
No general/miscellaneous or governing-law section is listed; likely in an unlisted trailing section — confirm forum and any arbitration clause.
No assignment heading in the outline; check the unlisted miscellaneous sections for a consent-to-assign or change-of-control termination right against us.

Ownership is most likely addressed in the licence grant (sec-2) with supporting definitions (sec-1); confirm we retain our marks, content and customer/loan data hosted by TrueLink, and that sec-10 protects that data.
Review sec-2 for scope, revocability and whether affiliates and contractors may use the licensed software and Hosting Services; sec-1 definitions ('Client', 'Hosting Services') drive that scope.
No audit heading; usage-verification or records-inspection rights against us are often tucked into Client covenants (sec-8) or fee reconciliation (sec-5).
Check sec-5 for late fees, early-termination charges or other stipulated sums payable by us; service credits in our favour are acceptable.
Sec-8 contains Client warranties only; a TrueLink performance/uptime warranty appears to be missing (possibly in an unlisted section) and should be added with a real remedy.
No insurance provision in the outline, though TrueLink hosts our site and consumer data; propose standard coverages including cyber/E&O.
Sec-5 (COMPENSATION) is where minimum fees, guaranteed volumes or take-or-pay hosting charges would appear; check for an exit if volumes fall short.
No transition or data-return provision surfaced; confidentiality (sec-10) may require return of materials but we need affirmative migration assistance and export of hosted data on exit.
